# Pteranodon (`monsters:pteranodon`)
*Medium beast, unaligned* | **CR** 1/4 (XP 50; PB +2)
**AC** 13 | **HP** 13 (3d8) | **Speed** 10 ft., fly 60 ft.
**STR** 12 (+1) | **DEX** 15 (+2) | **CON** 10 (+0) | **INT** 2 (-4) | **WIS** 9 (-1) | **CHA** 5 (-3)
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +1
**Senses:** Passive Perception 11
**Languages:** None

## Traits
- **Flyby.** The pteranodon doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.
